meta: Write a 30-second short-video script with AI: the first line decides whether viewers scroll past or stay.

muc.title: A few seconds decide
muc.text: Viewers decide to scroll or stay within the first few seconds, so the first line matters most.

muc.title: Three good ways to open
muc.text: Mark học AI opens with a result, a paradox or a common mistake, never a long greeting.

muc.title: Ask for five openers
muc.text: Give your video idea to a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, ask for five opening lines, and pick the one that makes you want to keep listening.

muc.title: One idea, one action
muc.text: Thirty seconds only fits a few short sentences, so ask AI to cut the extras and keep one idea and one thing to try.

muc.title: Score your opener
muc.text: Write the opening line for a video you plan to make, ask a chatbot to score it and rewrite it three ways.

thu: Write the opening line for a video you plan to make, ask a chatbot to score it 1-10 and rewrite it 3 ways.
